WITH ins AS
(
    INSERT INTO "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        ingest_pipeline_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        data_class,
        ingest_type,
        src_type,
        target_id,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        exec_group,
        condition_type,
        condition_frequency,
        condition_interval,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_column_type,
        incr_column_hw_val,
        incr_start_val,
        init_wait_yn,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,
        file_size_mb,
        start_dt,
        end_dt,
        extract_cnt,
        save_cnt,
        attempt_no,
        status,
        error_log,
        created_by,
        created_dt
    )
    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}',
        '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
        '-',
        'PL_' || m.data_class || '_' || m.src_type || '_'
        || CASE
               WHEN NULLIF(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm, '') IS NOT NULL
               THEN m.cdc_tgt_db_nm
               ELSE m.src_db_nm
           END,

        m.data_class,
        m.ingest_type,
        m.src_type,
        m.target_id,
        m.src_db_nm,
        m.src_schema_nm,
        m.src_table_nm,
        m.cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        m.exec_group,
        m.condition_type,
        m.condition_frequency,
        m.condition_interval,
        m.incr_column_nm,
        m.incr_column_type,
        m.incr_column_hw_val,

        CASE
            WHEN m.ingest_type = 'INCR'
            THEN '@{variables('v_start_value')}'
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        m.init_wait_yn,

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(m.src_type) = 'DB2' THEN
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || COALESCE(
                       NULLIF(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm, ''),
                       m.src_schema_nm
                   )
                || '.'
                || m.src_table_nm
                || CASE
                       WHEN m.ingest_type = 'INCR'
                        AND m.incr_column_nm IS NOT NULL
                       THEN ' WHERE '
                            || m.incr_column_nm
                            || ' > '''
                            || '@{variables('v_start_value')}'
                            || ''''
                       ELSE ''
                   END
                || ' WITH UR ;'

            WHEN UPPER(m.src_type) = 'MSSQL' THEN
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || m.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || m.src_table_nm
                || ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                || CASE
                       WHEN m.ingest_type = 'INCR'
                        AND m.incr_column_nm IS NOT NULL
                       THEN ' WHERE '
                            || m.incr_column_nm
                            || ' > '''
                            || '@{variables('v_start_value')}'
                            || '''' 
                       ELSE ''
                   END
                || ' ;'

            ELSE
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || m.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || m.src_table_nm
                || CASE
                       WHEN m.ingest_type = 'INCR'
                        AND m.incr_column_nm IS NOT NULL
                       THEN ' WHERE '
                            || m.incr_column_nm
                            || ' >  '''
                            || '@{variables('v_start_value')}'
                            || ''''
                       ELSE ''
                   END
                || ' ;'
        END,

        'ingest/'
        || m.data_class
        || '/batch_date=@{substring(variables('v_yyyyMMddHHmmss'),0,8)}'
        || '/batch_hour=@{substring(variables('v_yyyyMMddHHmmss'),8,2)}'
        || '/pipeline_name=@{pipeline().Pipeline}/',

        m.src_db_nm
        || '.'
        || m.src_schema_nm
        || '.'
        || m.src_table_nm
        || '.@{variables('v_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'
        || '.parquet',

        0,
        NOW(),
        NULL,
        0,
        0,
        0,

        '@{if(
            pipeline().globalParameters.g_skip_yn,
            'SKIPPED',
            'PENDING'
        )}',

        NULL,
        'ADF',
        NOW()

    FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master m
    WHERE m.data_class = '@{variables('v_data_class')}'
      AND m.ingest_type = '@{variables('v_ingest_type')}'
      AND m.condition_frequency = '@{variables('v_condition_frequency')}'
      AND m.condition_interval = @{variables('v_condition_interval')}
      AND m.init_wait_yn = 'N'
      AND m.delete_yn = 'N'

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        data_class,
        ingest_type,
        src_type,
        target_id,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        exec_group,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,
        attempt_no,
        status
)
SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    master_pipeline_nm,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    src_type,
    target_id,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
    exec_group,
    extract_query,
    landing_path,
    file_name,
    attempt_no,
    status
FROM ins
ORDER BY target_id;

UPDATE "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
SET
    status                 = 'RUNNING',
    start_dt               = NOW(),
    attempt_no             = attempt_no + 1,
    update_by              = 'ADF',
    update_dt              = NOW()
WHERE master_run_id       = '@{item().master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id  = '@{item().ingest_pipeline_id}';
